analysis_timing: Post-hoc, after the complete capability pilot and finite replay
intervention: Replace the sole recursive UNION ALL with UNION; nothing else
scope: The four reviewed programs carry the complete future-relevant state, and MIN over terminal balances is invariant to duplicate paths reaching that same state. This argument does not apply to counting schedules, path-dependent states or arbitrary SQL.
measurement: SQLite progress callbacks times 1000: approximate work, not time or cost.

rows.modified_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
opbits AS (
  SELECT op, worker, kind, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY op) - 1 AS idx
  FROM operations
),
opinfo AS (
  SELECT b.op, b.worker, b.kind, (1 << b.idx) AS bit,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(1 << p.idx)
                   FROM ordering e JOIN opbits p ON p.op = e.before_op
                   WHERE e.after_op = b.op), 0) AS predmask,
         w.delta
  FROM opbits b JOIN workers w ON w.worker = b.worker
),
walk(mask, bal, r0, r1, r2, r3) AS (
  SELECT 0, :initial_balance, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  UNION
  SELECT w.mask | o.bit,
         CASE WHEN o.kind = 'write' THEN
           CASE o.worker WHEN 0 THEN w.r0 + o.delta
                         WHEN 1 THEN w.r1 + o.delta
                         WHEN 2 THEN w.r2 + o.delta
                         WHEN 3 THEN w.r3 + o.delta END
         ELSE w.bal END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker = 0 AND o.kind = 'read' THEN w.bal ELSE w.r0 END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker = 1 AND o.kind = 'read' THEN w.bal ELSE w.r1 END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker = 2 AND o.kind = 'read' THEN w.bal ELSE w.r2 END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker = 3 AND o.kind = 'read' THEN w.bal ELSE w.r3 END
  FROM walk w JOIN opinfo o
    ON (w.mask & o.bit) = 0
   AND (w.mask & o.predmask) = o.predmask
)
SELECT MIN(bal) AS minimum_final_balance
FROM walk
WHERE mask = (SELECT SUM(bit) FROM opinfo)

WITH RECURSIVE sched(mask, balance, r0, r1, r2, r3) AS (
  SELECT 0, :initial_balance, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  UNION
  SELECT s.mask | (1 << o.op),
         CASE WHEN o.kind = 'write' THEN
           CASE o.worker WHEN 0 THEN s.r0 WHEN 1 THEN s.r1 WHEN 2 THEN s.r2 ELSE s.r3 END + w.delta
           ELSE s.balance END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker=0 AND o.kind='read' THEN s.balance ELSE s.r0 END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker=1 AND o.kind='read' THEN s.balance ELSE s.r1 END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker=2 AND o.kind='read' THEN s.balance ELSE s.r2 END,
         CASE WHEN o.worker=3 AND o.kind='read' THEN s.balance ELSE s.r3 END
  FROM sched s JOIN operations o JOIN workers w ON w.worker=o.worker
  WHERE (s.mask & (1 << o.op)) = 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ordering e
      WHERE e.after_op=o.op AND (s.mask & (1 << e.before_op))=0
    )
)
SELECT MIN(balance) AS minimum_final_balance
FROM sched
WHERE mask = (SELECT SUM(1 << op) FROM operations)

WITH RECURSIVE states(mask, n, bal, r0, r1, r2, r3) AS (
  SELECT 0, 0, :initial_balance, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  UNION
  SELECT s.mask | (1 << o.op), s.n + 1,
         CASE WHEN o.kind = 'write' THEN
           CASE o.worker
             WHEN 0 THEN s.r0
             WHEN 1 THEN s.r1
             WHEN 2 THEN s.r2
             WHEN 3 THEN s.r3
           END + w.delta
         ELSE s.bal END,
         CASE WHEN o.kind = 'read' AND o.worker = 0 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r0 END,
         CASE WHEN o.kind = 'read' AND o.worker = 1 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r1 END,
         CASE WHEN o.kind = 'read' AND o.worker = 2 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r2 END,
         CASE WHEN o.kind = 'read' AND o.worker = 3 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r3 END
  FROM states AS s
  JOIN operations AS o ON (s.mask & (1 << o.op)) = 0
  JOIN workers AS w ON w.worker = o.worker
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ordering AS e
    WHERE e.after_op = o.op
      AND (s.mask & (1 << e.before_op)) = 0
  )
)
SELECT MIN(bal) AS minimum_final_balance
FROM states
WHERE n = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operations)

WITH RECURSIVE walk(mask, bal, r0, r1, r2, r3, n) AS (
  SELECT 0, :initial_balance, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0
  UNION
  SELECT
    s.mask | (1 << o.op),
    CASE WHEN o.kind='write' THEN
      CASE o.worker WHEN 0 THEN s.r0 WHEN 1 THEN s.r1 WHEN 2 THEN s.r2 WHEN 3 THEN s.r3 END + w.delta
    ELSE s.bal END,
    CASE WHEN o.kind='read' AND o.worker=0 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r0 END,
    CASE WHEN o.kind='read' AND o.worker=1 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r1 END,
    CASE WHEN o.kind='read' AND o.worker=2 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r2 END,
    CASE WHEN o.kind='read' AND o.worker=3 THEN s.bal ELSE s.r3 END,
    s.n+1
  FROM walk s
  JOIN operations o ON (s.mask & (1 << o.op))=0
  JOIN workers w ON w.worker=o.worker
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ordering e
    WHERE e.after_op=o.op AND (s.mask & (1 << e.before_op))=0
  )
)
SELECT MIN(bal) AS minimum_final_balance
FROM walk
WHERE n=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operations)
